RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel alone does not prove discrimination, as it often reflects existing demographic imbalances in academic economics. However, combined with differing credentials (publications and doctorate completion versus industry background), implicit bias or affinity bias cannot be ruled out.

Before raising bias, politely follow up on your requested feedback. Check whether the university’s recruitment policy requires gender-diverse selection panels; an unapproved procedural violation is legitimate grounds for inquiry. Without scoring records or evidence that industry experience was arbitrarily weighed over academic criteria, alleging sex discrimination solely because the committee was all-male is difficult to substantiate and carries significant professional risks.
